entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I want to return this piece of garbage VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's completely useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A technical fault? The thing doesn't even read my pulse correctly! It's off by 30 beats a minute. It's garbage! I don't have time to mess around with settings or updates. I just want money back for it, now.
I understand your frustration. For a defect claim like this, our standard process is to connect you with our technical support team to verify the issue before we can authorize a return.

Absolutely not! I'm not getting passed around to another department. I don't have time for that nonsense. I'm telling you it's broken! Are you calling me a liar? Just give me my refund! I'm a VIP member, for crying out loud. I'll write a review so bad your company's stock will drop.

No, sir, not at all. I'm just following our standard procedure. Please allow me one moment to review your account and our policies. I see you are a valued VIP member, and I want to find the best solution for you.
You better. This is ridiculous. I expect better service from VeloFit.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've pulled up your purchase details from December 15th. Let's see... looking at our return policy here... you are absolutely correct to call. My apologies. The item is well within our 90-day return window. I can process that full refund for you immediately. No need for a transfer.
Finally! See? That's all I wanted. Why was that so difficult?

You're right to be frustrated, and I apologize for the delay. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the device, you'll see the full refund credited back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. As a VIP, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase, for the inconvenience.
Fine. Whatever. Just make sure that email comes through.
It will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
